name: 不锈钢薄型厨房电子秤款

styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless pure #FFFFFF packshot field, light-stone counter #E8E3DB and pale marble #F5F2ED for scenes and infographics, one graphite macro field #2E3033, one flat accent field #E4572E reserved for the closing frame
styleLock.lightingSystem: neutral 5500K studio light, front-left key with a white fill card, sweeping skimming highlights across brushed metal, soft contact shadows that always ground the product, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte light-stone counter #E8E3DB and pale marble #F5F2ED, brushed stainless platform reading as cool brushed metal, textured grey drawer liner #B9BFC6 for the storage scene
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; every headline and label zone stays as clean empty copy space, no rendered words at all
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons, flat accent #E4572E circles and rounded pills with deliberately blank interiors, empty shield outline and empty parameter rows as proof placeholders
styleLock.presentationRules: brushed stainless platform shown from above or at a slight 3/4, two unmarked membrane keys and one permanently dark blank display window facing camera, stable product scale and centring across the whole set
noDrift: no lit display digits or invented numbers
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean premium kitchen-tool visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless pure #FFFFFF packshot field, light-stone counter #E8E3DB, pale marble #F5F2ED, one accent #E4572E and headline ink #3E2A6E kept only as reserved empty copy space; neutral 5500K studio lighting with a front-left key and a white fill card, sweeping skimming highlights across brushed metal, soft contact shadows that always ground the product, no harsh speculars; modern geometric sans-serif; all copy zones left clean with no rendered words; thin single-weight line icons with flat accent circles and rounded pills whose interiors stay blank; brushed stainless platform photographed from above or at a slight 3/4 with the display window permanently dark and blank; stable product scale, angle and placement across the set; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no lit display digits, no invented numbers.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：01 白底俯视整块不锈钢秤面，屏上带读数、右下角两节电芯；02 台面 3/4 视角，白色烤碗装面粉，右侧大字标题与小字说明；03 平铺信息图，一碗浆果居中，左下一排圆形单位芯片、键位外一圈虚线高亮；04 控制端斜角特写，突出显示窗与两枚薄膜键，两行强调标题；05 高机位俯看秤平放进抽屉，旁边叠两只白盘，紫色标题加两行正文；06 三格竖排步骤图，空碗→手指按左键→碗中加浆果，右列编号圆点与说明文字；07 俯视秤面直接放生肉与香草，右上盾形徽标带星与材质等级字样，顶部两行强调标题；08 斜角特写，秤面立一枚圆柱金属砝码，顶部两枚胶囊标签写分度与量程；09 白底产品立于左侧，右侧蓝色世界地图加点位，紫字销量数字与两行品牌年表；10 上沿产品正视图加下方 2x4 八宫格用途缩略图，每格红底白字标签，底部紫色标题；11 家庭合影库存图，蓝色渐变压字，底部三个线框图标配专利/软件/商标数字；12 白台俯视平铺，小碗巧克力豆在秤面，右侧曲奇盘、红糖碗、面粉碗。品类判定依据：图为带 LCD 与薄膜键的不锈钢薄型台面称，无电机、无加热，属小件厨房器具，故按 taxonomy 归「家居日用 / 厨房用品」，leaf 为不锈钢厨房电子秤，而不归「家用电器 / 厨房电器」。已剥离内容：原品牌字标与系列名、店铺字样、机身铭牌上的量程与分度参数、屏上全部读数、电芯外皮标识、砝码刻字、全部英文标题与正文原句、材质等级与认证徽标字样、销量与社会证明数字、专利与商标数字、家庭成员可辨识面容与身份、平台角标与星级、世界地图品牌背书版式；上述均改为 {product} 占位或空白 proof placeholder（空显示窗、空参数胶囊、空圆芯片、空盾牌内板、空按钮药丸），屏幕一律写作空白无读数，精度与量程数值不入稿。
